text:
Alex (Product): Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. Can leadership confirm estimated ship windows for three items we called out: 1) Console rate-limit/config UI, 2) Optimize batching recommendation engine, 3) Streaming SDK changes (breaking? backwards compat?). Need firm dates for release notes and canary windows.

Maya R (Engineering): Console UI work is on track. Internal beta target week of Apr 11, public GA late Apr (still depends on infra soak). I'll add tasks to the release board.

Zoe (Runtime Eng): Streaming SDK changes: core runtime change is landed in main, integration tests next week. We're keeping API-compatible surface — non-breaking defaults. Canary target Apr 15 in us-west.

Devon (Infra): Autoscale + feature-flag infra work needed for Console rate-limit UI in Dedicated. ETA Apr 18 for infra changes, then 24h staging soak.

Ben (PM): For Optimize batching engine: plan is partner alpha May 2, public beta May 23. Alpha will be opt-in; we'll validate quality before GA.

Sam (Docs): I'll start a draft for user docs and migration notes. Need canary dates to lock the timeline.

Allison (CEO): Important: communicate opt-in windows clearly to enterprise customers (Dedicated/Private). Sales/CS need at least 2 weeks notice before GA.

Maya R (Engineering): Note: Console UI depends on the API exposing the rate-limit endpoints (PR #2783). @Zoe can you confirm API compatibility and feature-flag approach?

Zoe (Runtime Eng): Confirmed — API change is backwards compatible. We'll expose new endpoints behind a feature flag `rate_limit_ui_v1`. SDKs will ignore the new fields unless opt-in.

Devon (Infra): I'll create a migration runbook covering DB migration, feature-flag rollout, and canary host list. Will add a checklist in the runbook repo.

Alex (Product): Can we consolidate dates into one short list so I can publish in the engineering notes and the release email?

Ben (PM): Draft dates for review: Console internal beta Apr 11; Console GA Apr 28; Streaming SDK canary Apr 15; Optimize alpha May 2; Optimize beta May 23. Please confirm edits.

Maya R (Engineering): Confirmed except Console GA might slip +1 week if e2e flakiness shows up during canary. I'll flag any risks by Apr 7.

Sam (Docs): I'll set a doc freeze Apr 10 for internal beta material. Sam -> will post PRs for changelogs that day.

Allison (CEO): Sales: please prepare talking points and a short migration FAQ. Ops: prioritize quick-response support for the first 48h after GA.

infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: staging soak Apr 12 02:00 UTC -> Apr 13 02:00 UTC.

Alex (Product): Action items summary: Devon create runbook by Apr 5; Zoe confirm feature-flag rollout plan by Apr 6; Ben finalize partner list for Optimize alpha by Apr 8; Sam prepare comms draft by Apr 9. I'll follow up in the product sync and tag owners. :thumbsup:

Maya R (Engineering): Thanks — I'll update the release board and move items to 'canary' once infra runbook is in.

Devon (Infra): Will start the runbook and ping on-duties.

Ben (PM): I'll circulate the partner invite list and timeline to growth and partners.

Sam (Docs): Noted, will post drafts for review tomorrow.

Allison (CEO): Appreciate the quick coordination — let's keep the comms tight.

Alex (Product): Closing the loop here — if anyone spots blockers, drop them in this thread or bring to the product sync.
